name: Race for the Galaxy
summary: A simultaneous role-selection tableau-builder where players build galactic civilizations to score victory points.
rules_text: Players start with a home world and 4-6 cards in hand. The deck contains worlds and developments. Each round all players secretly pick one of seven action cards (Explore, Develop, Settle, Consume, Produce). All chosen phases occur in I-V order. In Explore all draw 2 cards then keep 1, bonuses give extra draws or keeps. In Develop players simultaneously place a development face-down then pay its cost by discarding cards from hand; the chooser gets -1 cost. In Settle they simultaneously place world cards, paying cost or conquering with military; windfall worlds get a face-down good from deck; chooser draws 1 card after. Consume lets players discard goods for VPs and cards; Produce places new goods on production worlds. Powers on tableau cards modify costs and draws. Hand limit 10. Game ends when a tableau reaches 12 cards or initial VP pool is nearly empty. Most VPs wins.
